about_the_game:
Portal Packs - Encounter Essentials - Hateful Hordes


Art by : Demonic Brute



Layout by: Anna Michelle Meservier


We know that running a campaign can be challenging. Thankfully we make planning for encounters easy! That's why our monster tokens are grouped together by level range allowing you to purchase a set of tokens appropriate to your groups level. As your players progress check out our catalog for the next level band.

Hateful Hordes contains tokens for common low level opponents including Orcs, Troglodytes, Hobgoblins etc. This pack is most appropriate for GM's running games for players 1-3 (occasionally higher.)

Additionally, we know aesthetics are important. To that end we've included 6 tokens for each race each in two versions. Unlike Token Essentials, we included full figure tokens here. Enjoy!

As always this pack is fully compatible with our Token Essentials, and One Minute Maps products.
"
